accepted: Scalar values, locals and ordinary control flow
Direct calls and methods selected by exact source declaration identity to another const-qualified free/inherent function
Shared field and enum projections
Constructors and identity transfers of generic, non-Copy or custom-Drop values when no destruction is emitted
conservative_refusals: Nonconst, trait or dynamic calls
Allocation and effect/heap intrinsics
Closure and try expressions
Mutable borrowing or mutation through a reference
Destruction that is not structurally trivial
const_functions.constant_initializers: Every function or method call in a module constant initializer still receives a located CTFE refusal, including a const-qualified call. Aggregate/reference compile-time evaluation is not claimed.
const_functions.declarations: const-qualified free and inherent functions; every definition is checked rigidly, including unused/unreachable definitions
const_functions.destruction: Each emitted Drop/DropIf needs structurally trivial destruction. Shared views do not destroy their referents; unknown rigid T requires Copy.
const_functions.qualification: The frontend checks lowered operations using exact ExprId and selected source declaration metadata; the checked IR and independent checker are unchanged.

accepted: Standalone array lengths, repeat counts and ordinary usize value expressions
Array-argument inference and explicit decimal usize literals or in-scope const parameters
Mixed type/const parameters, borrowed array receivers and associated array results
Recursive calls, static methods with explicit method arguments, and opaque-result captures that preserve const identity
conservative_refusals: Const parameter types other than builtin usize
Const defaults and arithmetic/braced constant arguments or array lengths
Const parameters on nominal types, aliases, trait declarations or trait methods
Implementation const parameters absent from the receiver
Module/global constants used as array lengths
Where predicates whose written target contains a symbolic array length
const_generics.declarations: Free functions, inherent functions, and implementation blocks whose receiver contains each const parameter.
const_generics.definition_checking: Each symbolic count remains distinct from literals and sibling parameters, even in unused definitions and branches. An impl for [T; 0] is not evidence for [T; N]; testing N == 0 does not add type equality. A symbolic repeat requires Copy before specialization.
const_generics.generic_argument_placement: The source frontend records the written generic-argument owner and final-segment flag, validates that owner in its original lexical scope before constructor/call selection, and routes receiver versus method arguments using syntax provenance. Modules cannot own generic arguments. Explicit inference occurrences have distinct identities and exact locations while retaining their refusal boundary.
const_generics.original_nom_limits: Compare at traits.rs:1099/1111 has N only in a positional trait argument, not its slice receiver. FindToken at 1123/1129 has const-bearing array receivers but still requires positional generic-trait support. The two AsBytes array receivers do not establish their original bodies or module admission.
const_generics.overlap_and_lowering: Const variables are independent of type variables in overlap checking. Specialization emits the existing concrete arrays, repeats and integer values; the checked IR and independent checker are unchanged.
const_generics.retained_argument_boundaries: Explicit generic-argument inference placeholders and multiple generic-argument lists in one path retain their existing located refusal boundaries.
const_generics.source_commands: Queries preserve symbolic lengths and const-parameter meaning; references cover type/value uses. Checked renames require a fresh spelling throughout the enclosing item and exact use sites; body edits revalidate symbolic identities.

accepted: Debug formatting ? and alternate #? for integers, bool, char, str/String, references, Box, slices/arrays/Vec, Option/Result, unit and tuples of one through twelve fields
Source DebugStruct, DebugTuple and DebugList builders preserve field order, alternate indentation and formatting errors
derive(Debug) on ordinary and generic structs/enums generates a checked implementation with generic field obligations
debug_formatting_and_derive.checked_ir: No raw-byte reflection, trusted formatting intrinsic or checker enlargement.
conservative_refusals: Float implementations and other container builders
x?/X? modes and dynamic width/precision
Arbitrary Write sinks; write!/writeln! currently target String or Formatter
debug_formatting_and_derive.source_commands: Trait/type/implementation and generated-method queries, exact checked renames and body edits, generated-edit/capture refusals, and ten malformed-origin controls on both engines.
debug_formatting_and_derive.unicode: Unicode 17.0.0 debug-escape table generated from independent scalar observations.

accepted: Associated families with named type parameters, parameter/result bounds and implicit or relaxed Sized requirements
Qualified and unambiguous projected applications, aliases, nested associated owners, method inputs/results and source replay
Uniform unused-definition checks under distinct implementation and family binders
Implementation parameters inferred from proven prerequisite associated equalities, retaining final bounds and exact applied identities
generic_associated_type_families.checked_ir: Families normalize in the untrusted frontend through existing types and calls. No trusted IR or checker enlargement.
conservative_refusals: Family lifetime/const binders, family defaults and type-outlives bounds
Written region-bearing family arguments or RHS definitions; uniform generic type arguments may carry borrowed actuals
Predicates on nonparameter targets and input contracts requiring deferred well-formedness
Missing/stronger/omitted input contracts, wrong arity, contradictory results and transparent or expanding cycles
generic_associated_type_families.identity: Receiver, resolved declaring trait with all positional arguments, associated member and ordered family arguments remain distinct; equal outputs never imply equal inputs.
generic_associated_type_families.inference: Borrowed unsized view context waits for unresolved owned match/block producers while ordinary sized constructor and closure context still propagates.
generic_associated_type_families.source_commands: Family signatures and types, exact member/binder references and renames, body edits, warm reuse and atomic refusal retain source proof identity.

accepted: Named lifetime-to-lifetime where predicates, including multiple bounds and enclosing-inherent-impl lifetimes
Directed unused-definition and call obligations through the existing region edges
Const-qualified functions with mixed lifetime/type/usize-constant binders and borrowed relaxed-Sized referents
lifetime_where.checked_ir: No checked-IR, independent-checker, library or runtime change.
conservative_refusals: Trait/trait-implementation method where lifetime predicates
Implementation-header where lifetime predicates
Anonymous/static and higher-ranked predicates
Type-outlives where predicates such as T: lifetime
Enclosing-lifetime substitution for paired trait inline bounds
lifetime_where.result_coverage_repair: The frontend skips only result-scope obligations already covered at the exact projection/region by ordinary returned-view checking; nested/invariant and mixed-elided result requirements remain checked.
lifetime_where.return_contracts: Free/inherent return origins can follow declared directed edges. Ordinary results preserve mutable-storage invariance; opaque result lifetimes require hidden references to outlive the result lifetime without equating their stored regions.
lifetime_where.scope: Both sides must resolve to declared names in the proper function/impl scope. Inline bounds share the declared-name checks; an impl header cannot borrow a lifetime declared only by its method.
lifetime_where.source_commands: Queries preserve written relationships and exact lifetime declaration references. Checked body edits and function renames retain constraints; invalid edits roll back and relevant frontend/header changes invalidate cached admission.
lifetime_where.trait_inline_bounds: Trait return origins retain exact lifetime-label agreement. Method-local inline lifetime edges must match after binder-position pairing; adding or dropping an edge rejects. Enclosing-lifetime edges remain refused pending owner substitution.

accepted: Borrowed str/slices and generic shared or mutable references through relaxed parameters
Nominal view aggregates whose fields are references to relaxed parameters
Additional ordinary bounds; explicit Sized, Clone or Copy can establish sizedness
Const usize parameters alongside relaxed type parameters; const values carry no Sized obligation
maybe_sized.associated_equalities: Equality bindings retain their ordinary contract meaning; they do not fabricate an implementation or grant a named relaxed right-hand parameter an extra Sized assumption. Concrete associated definitions must meet their declaration’s implicit bound.
maybe_sized.checked_ir: The checked IR and independent checker are unchanged.
conservative_refusals: Owned unsized parameters/results/locals and unsized tuple or nominal tails
Box<T>/Vec<T> without proven Sized elements; existing heap-held view limits remain
Relaxation of associated type declarations, explicit Self, concrete targets or anonymous impl-Trait parameters
Relaxing a same-spelled user trait rather than resolved builtin Sized
Duplicate relaxations and explicit implementations of builtin Sized
maybe_sized.const_interaction: [T; N] requires a Sized element even if a later call chooses zero. Associated array equalities preserve independent named count identities.
maybe_sized.default_contract: Named type parameters require builtin Sized unless relaxed with ?Sized inline or in a where predicate. Trait Self has no implicit Sized requirement; associated types retain theirs.
maybe_sized.definition_checking: The relaxed source contract is preserved under rigid checking even if later callers choose sized types. Private verifier layouts supply no Sized evidence. Ordinary calls, implementation prerequisites and method-signature comparison enforce implicit and explicit requirements.
maybe_sized.source_commands: Queries preserve written relaxed bounds and ordinary trait references. Checked renames and bound replacements revalidate callers, roll back refused changes and invalidate frontend checkpoints; unchanged authenticated images reuse normally.
maybe_sized.storage: Executable parameters/results/locals, array and slice elements, tuple/nominal fields require proven sized storage, including unused declarations and abstract signature components. An abstract trait signature may mention Self by value; an executable body must establish storage.

accepted: Declared trait type parameters in bounds, implementations, associated equalities, qualified members, supertraits and opaque results
Blanket implementation parameters bound through the applied trait as well as the receiver
Rigid unused-definition checking, declared argument bounds and implicit or relaxed Sized requirements
Concrete method implementation arguments inferred from input and result context, retained by exact expression/implementation/method identity and re-proven before specialization
positional_trait_arguments.borrowed_parameters: Uniform type parameters may instantiate borrowed values without inventing lifetime-specific witness equality.
positional_trait_arguments.checked_ir: Existing checked IR and independent checker are unchanged.
conservative_refusals: Trait lifetime and const parameters and explicit type inference placeholders
Written reference arguments, lifetime-parameterized nominal/alias arguments and projections normalizing to views until region-aware witness identity exists
Ambiguous implementation/input applications and cyclic or recursively expanding proof arguments
positional_trait_arguments.ownership: Inferred method applications select and prove a candidate; only receiver-derived or explicitly authored argument expectations authorize coercion and reborrowing. Unconstrained direct/nested mutable references still move.
positional_trait_arguments.source_commands: Applied signatures, projections, exact member/method references, checked rename and body replacement preserve the contract and reject invalid transactions atomically.
positional_trait_arguments.witness_identity: Receiver, resolved declaring trait and every positional type argument remain distinct; provided bodies and specialization retain the checked source recipe.

remaining_limits: Lifetime-bearing explicit trait arguments and trait const/lifetime parameters
Associated families with lifetime/const binders, defaults, type-outlives bounds or written region-bearing arguments/results
Nested opaque return positions and trait-method opaque results
Recursive opaque hidden-type inference and unsupported lifetime capture combinations
